title: The True Price of "Free" In-House Canvassing
content:
###  **The Appeal of "Free"** 

Some companies avoid the cost question entirely by using existing staff, or the owner's own time, to handle outreach. It feels like it costs nothing extra. 

###  **What Gets Missed** 

That time has a real cost — it is time not spent managing crews, closing sales, or running the parts of the business that only the owner or key staff can do. Free time is rarely actually free. 

###  **The Opportunity Cost** 

When an owner spends ten hours a week on outreach instead of running the business, the real cost is whatever those ten hours would have otherwise generated — often far more than the outreach itself produces. 

###  **A More Honest Comparison** 

Once the value of that time is factored in, a structured program that removes the task entirely is often the more cost-effective choice, not the more expensive one.
